facts.fact: The National Health Compact of 6 December 2025 commits the Government to roll out Electronic Medical Records to all districts, linking PHUs and referral hospitals, phased from high-volume districts; its action plan sets a costed strategy for the phased roll-out by 2027 and roll-out to all medical facilities by 2030.

The Compact's action plan names the Ministry of Health's Directorate of Policy Planning and Information (DPPI) as lead institution for both the costed EMR roll-out strategy (2027) and the roll-out of EMR to all medical facilities (2030).
